reviewer: scanner_integration independent source review; not the original Codacy inventory triager
method: Read the complete eight helper clusters containing the 50 reported sinks, their fixture creation and direct/nested call sites at immutable revision 1556d2e.
Trace route arrays, query construction, response-derived encoded resource identifiers, synthetic credentials and locally replaced trading/config callbacks individually.

Check native listener setup and local database lifecycle. Search the server entry point for redirect/Location responses; these selected API contracts specify JSON/status responses and do not accept redirect targets.
Verify all original blob hashes and unchanged sink lines, current blob hashes, unique occurrence IDs and disjointness from the previous 40 reviews.
limitations: Exactly these 50 original occurrence IDs are reviewed; this is not a file-level or rule-level exemption.
No source changes, test execution, fresh Codacy scan, platform ignores or remote closures are claimed.
The later non-loopback-interface regression at lines 1838-1909 is outside these 50 sinks; no claim is made that every request in the entire file uses loopback.
Static asset fixtures elsewhere in runTests use frontend/dist, whereas the database, settings, managed secrets and selected draft-resource persistence use the private mkdtemp root.
No untrusted redirect target was identified in the selected API flows; this does not introduce a general fetch redirect defense or claim production-wide SSRF immunity.
